import type { Meta, StoryObj } from '@storybook/react'
import { ScrollTriggerScene } from './ScrollTriggerScene'

const meta: Meta<typeof ScrollTriggerScene> = {
  title: 'Features/3D/ScrollTriggerScene',
  component: ScrollTriggerScene,
  parameters: {
    layout: 'fullscreen',
  },
  argTypes: {
    sections: {
      control: 'object',
      description: 'Sections to display along the path',
    },
    backgroundColor: {
      control: 'color',
      description: 'Background color of the scene',
    },
    className: {
      control: 'text',
      description: 'Additional CSS classes',
    },
  },
}

export default meta

type Story = StoryObj<typeof ScrollTriggerScene>

// Default story with standard configuration
export const Default: Story = {
  args: {
    sections: [
      { id: 'section1', title: 'Introduction', position: [0, 0, -10] },
      { id: 'section2', title: 'Features', position: [10, 0, 0] },
      { id: 'section3', title: 'Benefits', position: [0, 5, 10] },
      { id: 'section4', title: 'Conclusion', position: [-10, 0, 0] },
    ],
    backgroundColor: '#000011',
    className: '',
  },
}

// Minimal configuration with fewer sections
export const Minimal: Story = {
  args: {
    sections: [
      { id: 'start', title: 'Start', position: [0, 0, -10] },
      { id: 'end', title: 'End', position: [0, 0, 10] },
    ],
    backgroundColor: '#000011',
  },
}

// Custom path with more sections in a specific arrangement
export const CustomPath: Story = {
  args: {
    sections: [
      { id: 'intro', title: 'Welcome', position: [0, 0, -15] },
      { id: 'about', title: 'About Us', position: [10, 5, -5] },
      { id: 'services', title: 'Services', position: [15, 0, 5] },
      { id: 'portfolio', title: 'Portfolio', position: [10, -5, 15] },
      { id: 'testimonials', title: 'Testimonials', position: [0, 0, 20] },
      { id: 'contact', title: 'Contact', position: [-10, 0, 15] },
    ],
    backgroundColor: '#001122',
  },
}

// Different background color
export const AlternateTheme: Story = {
  args: {
    ...Default.args,
    backgroundColor: '#110022',
  },
}
